# Semi-Retired MD

> A physician-focused real estate investing platform founded by Kenji Asakura, MD and Letizia Alto, MD, offering courses, events, and resources for doctors building wealth through rental properties and financial independence.

Semi-Retired MD provides education and community for high-income physicians seeking to build passive income through real estate investing, with emphasis on tax strategies (REPS), short-term rentals, and achieving financial freedom. The platform is founded by practicing physicians who have successfully implemented these strategies themselves.

## Key Topics

- Real Estate Investing
- Short-Term Rentals
- Financial Independence
- Passive Income

## Core Courses & Programs

- [Zero to Freedom Waitlist](https://semiretiredmd.com/masterclass-now): Zero to Freedom course waitlist signup for comprehensive physician real estate investing education
- [Accelerating Wealth Course](https://semiretiredmd.com/accelerating-wealth): Course on short-term rentals and tax savings strategies specifically designed for physicians
- [100 Hours & $100K: Build Wealth with Short-Term Rentals](https://semiretiredmd.com/100hours): Guide to building wealth through short-term rentals in one year with tax strategy focus
- [Life on Your Terms Book Companion](https://semiretiredmd.com/loyt): Companion guide to the Life on Your Terms book by Kenji Asakura and Letizia Alto

## Events & Summits

- [2025 Summit VIP Pass](https://semiretiredmd.com/summit-2025): Lifetime access to 2025 Summit VIP event with Kenji and Leti for physician investors
- [2025 Prosperity Conference](https://semiretiredmd.com/prosperityconference): 2025 Prosperity Conference in Las Vegas partnered with Physician On FIRE for wealth building

## Getting Started & Educational Resources

- [Start Here](https://semiretiredmd.com/start-here-new): Getting started guide for physician investors new to real estate and the FIRE movement
- [How to Buy Your First Rental Property](https://semiretiredmd.com/how-to-buy-your-first-rental-property): Step-by-step guide to purchasing your first rental property with course waitlist integration
- [From Fear to First Deal Masterclass Replay](https://semiretiredmd.com/thriving-during-the-recession): Masterclass replay teaching real estate investment strategies for any market condition
- [Real Estate Investing Assessment Quiz](https://semiretiredmd.com/free-quiz): Free assessment quiz to evaluate your real estate investing suitability and readiness
